name: qldb-session
description: The transactional data APIs for Amazon QLDB Instead of interacting directly with this API, we recommend using the QLDB driver or the QLDB shell to execute data transactions on a ledger.

subcommands.name: send-command
subcommands.description: Sends a command to an Amazon QLDB ledger.

options.name: --session-token
options.description: Specifies the session token for the current command.

options.name: --start-session
options.description: Command to start a new session.

options.name: --start-transaction
options.description: Command to start a new transaction

options.name: --end-session
options.description: Command to end the current session

options.name: --commit-transaction
options.description: Command to commit the specified transaction

options.name: --abort-transaction
options.description: Command to abort the current transaction

options.name: --execute-statement
options.description: Command to execute a statement in the specified transaction

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
